content: Me niŋ Bepaŋdi kadakaniŋŋiŋ tumolokulimindok ninadilak
Bepaŋ, du welegedi hinek nabukahilelaŋ, unduŋ doktiŋa siloŋ tobogoŋ tinambeŋ. Du’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ adi wapum hinek hakamulak, wendoktiŋa kadakaniŋne hogohogok wanakaŋ tumolokutnambeŋ.
Tiŋa nehiyoutewalandaune titiŋ hogohidi nu foloŋ mu hakaneeŋ. Kadakaniŋ u beyakutnambune waliniŋ mintait.
Nu kadakaniŋnedok kaule mu tilat. Nu maŋgoŋ kadakaniŋ tugut u uŋgoŋ hatinadilat.
Dauge foloŋ kadakaniŋ tugut, u du dauge foloŋgoŋ tugut, tiŋa welege tubukadakagut. Unduŋ doktiŋa du titiŋ didimeniŋ tiŋa mede gineŋ napmeeŋ kadakaniŋnedok kibikoŋ tubu-udanenamulaŋ.
Du agaŋ nadilaŋ, maŋ weleŋ gineŋ tububihila kadakaniŋnit mintagut. Tiŋa maŋdi nanagikuk u kadakaniŋ bumbut nanagikuk.
Nu welenedi hinek du gehikeledok nadinamulaŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa nadinadige momooŋ fuliŋ u nanindidimeweŋ.
Du kadakaniŋne tumolokulune waliniŋ mintait. Nehiyoutelune haule fafau youtetne diweiŋ u kalakapme tiŋa waliniŋ hinek mintawit.
Nehitubu-lodaune kotigoŋ welenadifo tubumintait. Biyagoŋ hinek kadakaniŋnedok kibikoŋ agaŋ nehitifofoŋ hinek tiŋa tubu-udanenamuŋaŋ. Kaŋ yoŋ adi agaŋ kotigoŋ welenadifo tibe nadilat.
Unduŋ doktiŋa du kadakaniŋne hogohogok tumolokutnambeŋ, tiŋa kadakaniŋne u kotigoŋ mu yabeŋ.
Bepaŋ, du welene gitipmuŋ waliniŋ tutumbaweŋ. Tiŋa titiŋ momooŋ diniŋ munabut u nehitubu-kaikaune du hogok gehikelewit.
Du hebeke gineniŋ mu nehikelekuleŋ, tiŋa Munabulige uŋgoniŋ mu nolomtibeŋ.
Du koom kadakaniŋ gineniŋ nehikibidali nanagikuŋ kaŋ nadifo tugut, nadifo u kotigoŋ tubukaikanambeŋ. Eŋ medege takalidok weleyouyout tinambeŋ. Tiŋa nehitubu-kilitibune undugoŋ tiluwaat.
Unduŋ tiŋale metam kadakaniŋ tiiŋ heki u du’walaŋ titiŋ momooŋ u yeniŋtitiŋenewe kaneeŋ. U kaŋ kotigoŋ udaneeŋ du’walaŋkade buneeŋ.
Bepaŋ, du kubugoŋdi kotigoŋ nanagitaŋ, wendoktiŋa siloŋ tobogoŋ tinamuŋa mu nulukumumbeŋ. Unduŋ tibeŋ kaŋ nu titiŋ didimeniŋ tilaŋ wendok yohautaaŋ kap fee tobit.
Wapum, du mamne taŋakiyeune manedi didimeŋgoŋ yohautaaŋ wohoge ganintiloit.
Du kale moŋgola buŋa dumuŋ hemundumunduŋe tigamdok u moŋ nadilaŋ. Nu kale ula kudup foloŋ hewene dadapmaŋ tibek iŋgoŋ du wendok maaŋ nadifo mu tilaŋ.

Unduŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋ, nu natok nadiwene fofoŋnit tubune du’walaŋ hebeke foloŋ welemulap tilat. Wondi siloŋ tigamulat. Nu agaŋ nadilat, du adi me nediyeŋ kadakaniŋŋiŋdok tiŋa malabumuŋ nadiŋa netok nadiune fofoŋnit tilak, aditok adi sigilulum mu timilaŋ.
O Bepaŋ, da nadilaŋ unduŋ tiŋa Saiyonhi metamdok titiŋ momooŋ tiyembeŋ. Tiŋa Jelusalem diniŋ gimbahaŋ u kotigoŋ tutumbayembeŋ.
Kaŋ du nai uŋaniŋ siloŋ didimehi eŋ momohi tigamneem wendok nadiune utumba tibaak. Indi kale kudupdi dadapmandok u maaŋ hegamneem. Eŋ makau maaniŋ u altage foloŋ dumuŋ hemundumunduŋe tigamneem.
